value.rationale: This is a natural complete local-p-torsion stratification of an exceptional, finite, geometrically significant gonality class, adding intrinsic Jacobian a-numbers to Weil/automorphism data. Exact four high-a cases concentrated in characteristic three and absolute absence of superspecial members are meaningful sharp boundaries rather than an arbitrary subset. The code makes the entire finite classification reproducible; no broader theorem or independent audit is claimed.
